name: File Manager UI quality and features

description: Baseline: File Manager at default size (72x20). Plain directory listing, no markdown preview, monochrome icons, minimal chrome. All axes below 6.

Responsive sizing (85% screen), directory preview with contents listing, file type icons (ts/js/md/json-specific), file sizes in list, JSON pretty-print, markdown rendering via renderMarkdownFile. Fixed directory crash.
Breadcrumb navigation in toolbar, total file size in status bar, docs/ folder with md files visible. Readability and coherence improved.

Tags enabled on preview pane. Coloured directory preview: cyan dir icons, green file bullets, bold headers, coloured overflow counts. Coloured line numbers (gray) for code/text files. Escaped braces in content.
Dynamic title bar showing current dir. Directory child counts in preview (3), (5). File sizes in dir preview. Keyboard shortcuts in status bar. 38% list split ratio. Readability and coherence jumped.
Coloured file type icons in list (green md, cyan dirs, yellow ts/js, magenta json, gray sizes). Tags enabled on list. Colour consistency between list and preview panes. Coherence jumped to 9.

Search overhaul: colour-coded results (yellow ts, green md), match line arrow in preview, result count in title bar, bold file headers. Plus: spacebar Quick Look, c=copy path, o=reveal in Finder, right-click context menu, file type distribution bar in dir preview. All new keyboard shortcuts in status bar.

Browse view screenshot (src/services) - same code as #7. Colour-coded ts/py/sh file list, parent dir preview with child counts and type distribution. Layout slightly weaker than search view since preview has empty space.
Browse view with quick stats (Largest/Recent) in dir preview. Adaptive max items based on preview height. Still empty space in dir preview for small directories. Doesn't beat search view at 9.0.
